blocks.title: About us
blocks.body:
Test Cafe / tea stall is a cafe / tea stall in Rewari since 2015. We offer tea & coffee, snacks & bakes, takeaway, office orders. We give every customer our full time and tell the price before we start.

Fresh every cup, Clean, calm place, Friendly service — that is how we work. How it goes: Drop in or message → Choose from the menu → Sit back or take away. Message us on WhatsApp and we reply quickly — for Rewari and nearby.
